name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through racing, but through a deep fascination with the engineering complexities of high-performance machinery. After graduating at KAIST with a degree in mechanical engineering, he spent his early career working on cutting-edge robotics projects, honing his skills in precision engineering and problem-solving. A chance encounter at a local karting event sparked his passion for racing, leading him to transition to motorsport, initially as a data analyst before quickly rising through the ranks. 

Known for his pragmatic and data-driven approach, Park emphasizes methodical analysis and continuous improvement. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment within his engineering team, valuing open communication and the sharing of ideas. His calm demeanor and ability to make decisive decisions under pressure are highly valued by his team and drivers alike. Park's distintive approach is his focus on holistic kart design, not just the engine, but the kart as a single system. 

He joined Birel ART Factory with the vision of integrating his expertise in advanced materials and predictive analytics to enhance the kart's performance on the track. He is committed to developing innovative solutions that will give the team a competitive edge, always striving for excellence in every aspect of the engineering process.
